subject: Concierge Retainer and Spot Coverage — FinStack engagement
messages:
From: Claire Dunn <claire@finstack.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ross Thompson <ross@finstack.io>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Concierge retainer + spot coverage — quick questions

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the KV cache behavior. We're trying to lock down support and SLA terms ahead of a POC (starts Jan). Two quick asks from procurement and our SRE lead: 

- Do you offer a small "concierge" retainer (monthly) that includes guaranteed bi-weekly check-ins, priority triage, and a 1-hour high-priority response window?
- Can we add a small pool of "spot coverage" hours (on-call bursts) charged as a monthly bundle that we can use for incident assistance or runbook run-throughs?

We have a constrained budget for the pilot — looking for a simple structure that covers: 99.9% regional uptime, on-call triage (1 hour), and 8 spot hours per month. If you can send a ballpark or a short options table, that would be great.

Also — are there any discounts for committing to a 6-month pilot with a conversion credit if we move to reserved capacity?

Appreciate it,

Claire Dunn
Head of SRE
FinStack

Attachments: none

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Concierge retainer + spot coverage — quick questions

Jonas / Laura — forwarding FinStack's ask (see below). They want a compact concierge retainer + a small monthly bucket of spot hours for the Jan POC. Key constraints: pilot (6 months), budget-conscious, needs 1-hour P1 triage and 8 spot hours / month, target regional uptime 99.9%.

Questions for pricing:
- What is a minimal monthly retainer we can offer that buys the 1-hour P1 response window and bi-weekly check-ins?
- How to structure 8 spot hours so it's attractive but doesn't create heavy on-call burden; recommend an hourly burn-rate or a pre-paid block with rollover?
- Any conversion credit we should commit to if they move to Dedicated? (we generally offer X% credit of retainer against first 6 months of Dedicated)

I drafted two quick structures in my head: 
A) Concierge Lite — $6k/mo retainer for bi-weekly 30-min check-ins, priority triage (1-hour P1), and access to a dedicated channel; spot hours billed at $325/hr or as 8-hr bundle at $2,400/mo.
B) Concierge Pilot — $3.5k/mo retainer (limited check-ins monthly), P1 triage within 2 hours (upgraded to 1 hour for one incident / month) and 8 spot hours included, with conversion credit of 30% of total retainer paid applied to first Dedicated commit.

I'd like your take on where we can be flexible and what approval I need to offer Pilot B vs A. I can send the proposal to Claire once we align.

Forwarded message follows below.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Concierge retainer + spot coverage — quick questions

Mina — thanks for the context. High level guidance below. I think Pilot B is the better commercial conversation to get them over the line; we can keep A as our anchor if procurement pushes for a fuller package.

Pricing guardrails (recommended):
- Minimum retainer floor: $3k/mo (anything below becomes admin-heavy for CS on ad-hoc triage).
- Offer Pilot B at $3,750/mo: includes monthly 60-min strategic check-in, guaranteed 1-hour P1 triage for one incident/month, and 8 spot hours included (non-rollover).
- Spot hour overage rate: $375/hr.
- Conversion credit: 25% of total paid retainers during pilot applied as a one-time credit against first 6 months of Dedicated commit (must be within 90 days of conversion).
- Commit discount threshold: 12-month Dedicated commit -> additional 10% off list for first year.

Operational constraints / internal notes:
- Laura: finance needs to confirm the acceptable credit accrual language and any revenue recognition concerns for the credit. If we must limit the credit to a fixed $ amount instead of a percentage, propose $11k cap.
- CS: we should limit the guaranteed 1-hour P1 to one incident/month (after that we revert to standard triage SLAs) to avoid unlimited exfil of hours.

If you want, I can greenlight Pilot B at $3,750 with a $11k cap on conversion credit (to keep finance happy).

Jonas
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

On a related note — suggest we include a short SOW (2 pages) describing what counts as a P1 and the playbook for spot-hour engagement to avoid ambiguity.

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dunn <claire@finstack.io>
Cc: Ross Thompson <ross@finstack.io>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Concierge Retainer and Spot Coverage — FinStack engagement (proposal)

Hi Claire (and Ross),

Thanks for the clear parameters — attached is a short proposal and a draft SOW that maps to the pilot terms we discussed. TL;DR of the offer:

- Concierge Pilot: $3,750 / month (6-month pilot recommended)
  - Monthly: one 60-minute tactical/strategic check-in
  - Operational: guaranteed 1-hour P1 triage for one incident per month
  - Coverage: 8 spot hours / month included (no rollover) for runbook exercises, incident assistance, or focused ops support
- Overage: $375 / hour after the included bucket is exhausted
- Conversion credit: 25% of total pilot retainers applied as a one-time credit to the first 6 months of Dedicated commit (cap $11,000). Credit must be claimed within 90 days of conversion.
- SLA: regional uptime target 99.9% (SLA credits spelled out in SOW)

Next steps / asks from your side:
1) Confirm that the 1-hour P1 for one incident/month is acceptable.
2) Confirm you want the conversion-credit as percent (25%) with $11k cap — we can reformat to a fixed credit if you prefer.
3) Sign the attached two-page SOW + proposal PDF and return; I can follow up with a short DocuSign if that's easiest.

I've attached: FinStack_Retainer_Proposal_20261112.pdf (proposal + pricing table) and Statement_of_Work_draft.docx (SOW + playbook excerpt).

If you want to squeeze price lower, we can convert to a smaller retainer ($3k/mo) but reduce the included spot hours to 4/mo or limit the guaranteed 1-hour P1 to a single incident every other month.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the SOW.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- FinStack_Retainer_Proposal_20261112.pdf (proposal + pricing table)
- Statement_of_Work_draft.docx (SOW + playbook excerpt)
